title: Tandoori Lamb Tacos
description: A fusion of Indian and Mexican flavors, where tender lamb is marinated in a rich and aromatic tandoori spice blend and served in a crispy taco shell.

ingredients.name: tandoori spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most Indian grocery stores

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the yogurt, tandoori spice blend, curry powder, nutmeg, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper (if using), salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb to the marinade and mix until the meat is well coated.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Remove the lamb from the refrigerator and let it sit at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Heat a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Add a tablespoon of oil and swirl it around.
Remove the lamb from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
Sear the lamb in the skillet for 2-3 minutes per side, or until it is browned and caramelized.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast the lamb for 15-20 minutes, or until it is cooked through and reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
While the lamb is cooking, warm the taco shells according to the package instructions.
Once the lamb is cooked, remove it from the skillet and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Slice the lamb into thin strips and serve it in the warmed taco shells, garnished with cilantro and lime wedges, if desired.
